Dear [Miss Smith](/person/263)
I hope that in a day or two you will receive the proof of your [Royal Household](/place/262), which I should be much obliged to you to look over and return to

[Messrs Mozley](/organisation/108)

Friar Gate

Derby

I am setting off to see the Manchester Exhibition[^1] and from thence most probably to Ireland, so that you may judge my time and head are not in the most favorable state for correcting

yours sincerely

C M Yonge


[^1]: The Manchester Art Treasures Exhibition, which had opened in May 1857.
